Error: No such command 'work-design'.

acceptance_criteria: Every child request, protected merge, native terminal state, contract or implementation root, review, test, and installed readback verifies and binds the same final protected source lineage.
The legacy 2026-07-05-kungfu-skill-productization card has a complete evidence-backed terminal disposition with no duplicate or abandoned responsibility.
Instruction-only, operational, and domain Skills preserve their class and authority boundaries across registry, Work selection, Agent Pack, GUI, TUI, CLI, managed runs, audit, history, and recovery.

All six Agent decisions are deterministic and explainable; auto-draft never installs or activates; every effectful, KFX, Profile, capability, credential, network, external-write, shared, publication, identity, privacy, destructive, evidence-strength, or historical decision remains plan-only or explicitly authorized.
CLI, GUI, TUI, Agent, managed-run, and installed-package results bind the same exact Skill, KFX, Profile, Work, plan, receipt, trust, audit, and recovery roots for the qualification fixtures.

Concurrency, crash, partial mutation, stale plan, missing and revoked dependency, prompt injection, provider disagreement, path escape, overwrite, history replay, removal, rollback, and recovery campaigns pass without lost or reinterpreted evidence.
The relevant current platform matrix produces honest source and installed-product evidence; an unavailable platform is reported unqualified and cannot be summarized as green.
A fresh-context independent reviewer reports no P0, P1, or material P2 authority, lifecycle, privacy, recovery, fragmentation, or product usability finding.
Family reconciliation proves every acceptance row and child terminal or opens exact residual-only child Assignments before the gate closes; the parent never accumulates an unowned tail.

complexity_governance.complexity_budget: One terminal evidence package and one family reconciliation over existing authorities; no new permanent evidence system.
complexity_governance.delegation_boundary: Agents may verify, fix bounded defects, review, merge, and reconcile; new product scope, authority, privacy, destructive history, marketplace, or public claims require a new explicit decision.
complexity_governance.human_load_reduction: One terminal package replaces manual reconciliation across seven cards, old debt, many surfaces, and mixed evidence.
complexity_governance.kill_or_archive_condition: Do not close while any material row is partial, missing, invalidated, or unowned; do not open a successor when every row is proved.
complexity_governance.recovery_without_user: Resume from exact child roots, protected cut, installed artifacts, fault reports, reviews, reconciliation root, native next_actions, and residual-only successor coordinates.

dependency_identities.required_use: Prove every responsibility retained, superseded, delivered, or explicitly deferred before closure.
Reverify the current protected KFX authority lineage and preserve its non-duplication invariants.

hierarchy.next_wave_rule: Open only exact residual responsibility that remains partial, missing, invalidated, or newly required by current evidence; if every row is proved, close the family without a successor wave.

mission_responsibility.why_matters: Only exact installed qualification and residual-free reconciliation can turn the Skill architecture into a trustworthy user and Agent product capability.

workDefinition.objective: Independently qualify the complete Kungfu Skill Agent-native product system on one exact protected and installed cut, reconcile every child and the legacy Skill productization responsibility, prove authority, lifecycle, decision, authoring, multi-surface, fault, recovery, and privacy invariants, and either close the family with no residual or publish only evidence-backed residual next-wave Assignments.
safety_boundaries: This child is an independent terminal gate; it may fix only bounded defects required to satisfy existing acceptance and must not silently expand product scope.
Use exact protected and installed artifacts plus temporary homes and fixtures; never mutate live user Skills, ~/.kungfu, credentials, private work state, or external systems to manufacture evidence.
Do not weaken tests, validators, required checks, review identity, branch protection, authority boundaries, privacy limits, or negative fixtures to obtain a pass.
Do not delete immutable requests, receipts, histories, failures, TrustReports, audit evidence, protected artifacts, or old-cut interpreters.
Do not make public release, adoption, standards, security, stability, or business claims beyond the retained exact-cut evidence.

Use canonical isolated worktrees, focused English DCO pull requests for bounded fixes, required checks, independent review, protected merge, exact installed readback, native closeout, and scoped Atlas reconciliation.

excluded: Manufacturing a favorable conclusion from green summaries, model confidence, local-only state, stale receipts, incomplete platform runs, or an open pull request.
Marketplace, hosted distribution, public release promotion, adoption or business claims, unrelated provider automation, branch-protection changes, or gate weakening.
Deferring known in-scope defects to a vague future card, deleting failure evidence, or closing only the Atlas pointer while native or repository state remains open.
included: Verify every prior child from immutable Assignment, protected merge, contract root, plan and receipt, test, review, installed artifact, and native terminal evidence rather than Atlas status or PR labels alone.

Freeze one exact protected dev/v4/v4.0 cut and qualify source, package, installed CLI, Agent Pack, GUI, TUI, managed-run, Agent Console, Skill registry, KFX and Profile dependency, and audit surfaces against it.
Run the six-outcome Skill decision matrix, safe auto-draft loop, install and activation separation, same-root cross-surface parity, Work-scoped selection, per-run audit, and recovery dogfood.

Run adversarial and fault campaigns for duplicates, stale roots, concurrency, partial install, crash, revoked and untrusted KFX, conflicting Work binding, prompt injection, hidden effects, provider disagreement, privacy leakage, rollback, and historical replay.

Produce one machine-readable family reconciliation and human-readable bounded judgment; close the legacy card and parent only when no owned residual remains, otherwise capture a bounded residual-only next wave.

target_repository.integration_policy: Qualify one exact protected and installed cut after all dependencies merge; any bounded remediation uses focused independently reviewed protected pull requests, then regenerate exact evidence and reconcile the native family before closure.

workDefinition.title: Kungfu Skill product qualification and residual-only continuation
